notes: The *when* of *when we come* is `added`: the Hebrew clause has hinneh, a pronoun and a participle, and no conjunction to carry it (rule 55).
The ASV writes *which ... by* rather than a pronominal adverb, so the relative and the preposition each take a word and the resumptive suffix is the unrendered occurrence (rule 22).
One determiner (*this*) is written for the whole nominal, so both the article on ha-shani and the article on ha-zeh are unrepresented (rules 29, 41).
